title: RuntimeAdapter
description: C6 (draft): wire protocol between the core and an agent runtime: a runtime adapter (a plugin of a foreign runtime, which may be Python) or the engine `ulei-engine`. The runtime is the server and serves the operations in `x-methods`; the core and other local callers are clients: each is `POST /v1/<name>` with the input as the JSON body over HTTP/1.1 on a unix socket, one request per connection; a `200` answer carries the output and any other status carries `Error` (`x-transport`, `x-error`, ADR-0008). Methods: `inject`, `is_idle`, `status`, `submit_turn`, `interrupt`, `set_route`, `skills_dir`, `mcp_register`, `raw_sessions`, `owner_channel`; session and turn semantics: ADR-0028.

x-transport.protocol: HTTP/1.1 with JSON bodies over a SOCK_STREAM unix socket; the runtime (adapter or engine) listens, the client (the core or another local caller) connects
x-transport.request: `POST /v1/<name>` with the method input as the body; `Content-Length` required, `Transfer-Encoding` refused
x-transport.response: `200` with the method output as the body; every other status with `Error` as the body; `Content-Type: application/json`, `Content-Length`, `Connection: close`
x-transport.connection: one request per connection; the server closes after its answer
x-transport.peer_check: each side refuses a peer whose SO_PEERCRED uid differs from its own effective uid; the client checks before it sends any byte

Error.description: Body of every non-200 answer. `message` is a short diagnostic that never echoes the payload.

ErrorCode.description: Error class; the HTTP status of each is fixed in ADR-0008.

InjectRequest.description: Inject an inbox event (C1) into the runtime's owner session when that session is free: no turn runs and no turn is queued. Idempotent on `event_id` and `attempt` together.

lease.description: Inbox lease of the core's claim. Data only: the runtime never calls the inbox, never acks and never settles the event.

attempt.description: Delivery attempt: C1 `Row.attempts` of the core's claim. A replay with a recorded `event_id` and `attempt` answers the recorded turn and starts nothing; a higher `attempt` of a recorded `event_id` is a new delivery and a new turn.

accepted.description: The runtime took the event into a turn.

session_id.description: Session that received the event: the session key for the engine. Present when accepted.

retry_after_s.description: Busy: retry after this many seconds. Present when not accepted.

turn.description: The turn that received the event; present when accepted.

IdleStatus.description: Whether the owner's session, the one `inject` targets, is free: no turn runs and no turn is queued.

idle.description: No turn is running or queued.

since.description: Unix time since when it is idle.

SessionKey.description: Session key: the engine's `--session` name and C8 `Session.key`. It names the key's current session; the engine creates the session on the key's first turn.

RouteAlias.description: A qb route alias, as C4G `TurnRequest.route`.

TurnId.description: Identity of one accepted turn, given when the turn is accepted, queued or started, and never given to another turn of the same runtime, across restarts.

TurnState.description: Where a turn is: `queued` waits in its session's queue, `running` runs, `ended` ran to an `outcome`, `dropped` left the queue by `interrupt` without running, `unknown` the runtime does not hold this turn (never accepted, or its report is gone).

TurnOutcome.description: How an ended turn ended: `completed` the model answered and stopped, `max_steps` the turn reached its step limit, `halted` a policy ended the turn, `interrupted` `interrupt` stopped it, `context_exhausted` compaction could not make a step fit, `quota_exhausted` every login of the route is out of quota, `failed` any other gateway, transport or runtime failure.

TurnReport.description: One turn as the runtime holds it.

outcome.description: How the turn ended; present when `state` is `ended`.

ended.description: Unix time the turn ended or was dropped; present for `ended` and `dropped`.

line.description: The one line an ended turn reports instead of an answer: for `quota_exhausted` the route and its nearest reset in UTC, for `context_exhausted` and `failed` the reason. Absent for the other outcomes.

StatusRequest.description: Read the state of one session and, with `turn`, of one of its turns.

turn.description: A turn of the session to report as `turn` of the answer.

SessionStatus.description: State of one session. A key without a session reads idle with an empty queue and no turn.

running.description: A turn of the session is running.

since.description: Unix time since when the session is running or idle: the start of the running turn, the end of the last turn, or the runtime's start.

queue_depth.description: Turns waiting in the session's queue.

route.description: The route alias the session's next turn runs on: the one `set_route` stored, else the runtime's default.

last_turn.description: The turn that ended last; absent before the first one.

turn.description: The turn the request named; present when it named one.

SubmitTurnRequest.description: Run one owner prompt as one turn of a session: at once when the session is idle, else after the turns queued before it.

prompt.description: The owner's prompt, the user message of the turn.

channel.description: The channel the prompt came on, as the engine's `--channel`.

new.description: Start a new session of the key for this turn, as the engine's `--new`, when the turn starts; the previous session stays in the journal. Absent means false.

SubmitTurnResponse.description: Result of `submit_turn`. A full queue refuses the prompt: `accepted` false and `queue_depth` 32.

accepted.description: The turn started or joined the queue.

turn.description: The accepted turn; present when accepted.

position.description: 0 when the turn started, else its place in the queue from 1; present when accepted.

queue_depth.description: Turns waiting in the session's queue after the call.

InterruptRequest.description: Stop the running turn of a session at once; the session and its history stay.

InterruptResponse.description: Result of `interrupt`. An idle session answers `interrupted` false and changes nothing.

interrupted.description: A turn was running and was interrupted.

dropped.description: The queued turn that was next and was dropped; absent when the queue was empty.

queue_depth.description: Turns left in the session's queue; they run in order after the interrupted turn.

SetRouteRequest.description: Run the session's later turns on a route alias. Stored with the session (C8 `Session.route`) until a new session of the key.

RouteSet.description: Result of `set_route`: the alias in force for the session's next turn.

McpServer.description: Register the core MCP facade (C2) in the runtime.

RawSessionsQuery.description: Read raw sessions of the runtime (the forest layer of memory).

cursor.description: Next cursor; absent at the end.

OwnerChannel.description: The owner's channel as the runtime knows it. Opaque to the core.
